preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
Length of each array is between 5 and 500.
Sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in array)
preconditions.description: Each element in the arrays is between 1 and n.
Each array has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(array)) == n for array in arrays[:n])
preconditions.description: First n arrays are permutations of n integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(array)) == n for array in arrays[n:])
preconditions.description: Last n arrays are permutations of n integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(any(array[i] == arrays[n + i][j] for j in range(n)) for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: For each i, there exists at least one position k such that the k-th element of the i-th array and the (n + i)-th array is the same.

preconditions.expression: all(any(array[i] != arrays[j][i] for i in range(n)) for j in range(2 * n) for i in range(j))
preconditions.description: No two arrays are completely equal.

postconditions.description: The number of good subsets is between 0 and 998244353.
The number of indices in the good subset is exactly n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= 2 * n for index in indices)
postconditions.description: Each index in the good subset is between 1 and 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(arrays[index - 1][i] for index in indices)) == n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The selected arrays form a Latin square.
